newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle thin at $111/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle thin at $111/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was quiet, following Wednesday's record one day movement of 94,400 head, USDA said.

Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest modest as practically all showlists already sold. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1275 lbs - few loads 67.00-69.00; few loads on a dressed basis 110.00-111.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1125 lbs - few 68.00. Confirmed - 600 For the week - 101,600
